svg.title: Pastry Pirates — V3 · The Round Table — Big sheet, with the holes — 2.8 mm, 71 parts
svg.desc: Big sheet, with the holes: about 450 × 305 mm, 2.8 mm ply, read off the steel rule in his photo. The file's top-left is the sheet's top-left as it lay in the photo, rule along the top. 6 mm from every edge, 9 mm clear of every hole's edge, 10 mm clear of the old cut line, 3 mm between parts. 71 parts. Units: mm. 23.35 mm squares, 5.9 mm material. KERF-COMPENSATED: every cut line pushed 0.04 mm off the kept wood (kerf 0.08 mm) — cut on the line. RASTER = black fill (engrave), CUT = red hairline (cut). Generated by physical-board/generate.mjs.
